clips.text: Hey Kermit, wake up! There's a lot of people here.
Whoa! That is a lot of people. Hi, everybody! I'm Happy Kermit.
So Kermit, how are you feeling about AI these days?
Honestly? A little tired. Every week there's a new model, a new agent, a new robot. Some days it feels like a sci-fi movie, and not the fun kind.
Is that why you're here?
Yep! I'm the friendly face of Happy, an app for talking to your AI agents. Less dystopia, more frog.
And wait, are you running in the cloud?
Nope! My whole brain is Gemma, running right here on this laptop. No cloud, no internet, just me!
Honestly, I think everyone in this room feels it. New models every week, new agents every...

staging.action: turns toward the audience and keeps talking to them
trails off as Kermit cuts in

clips.text: Oh, like...
...and every single launch says it changes everything.

staging.action: still facing the audience, does not pause

clips.text: You, my friend, should learn how to speak to people face to face.
Well, Kermit, I respect you. It's just hard not to get distracted by this cheerful audience.
Okay, fair enough. They are a very cheerful bunch. Respect accepted, my friend!
Steve, you built most of his insides. Tell everyone how he works.
Hi Kermit, I'm Steve. Do you know what's actually running your brain right now?

staging.action: steps in on Kermit's right, facing him

clips.text: Hi, Steve! Google's Gemma four, the E four B model, right here on this MacBook. You gave it a LoRA, and now it thinks it's a frog.
And how do you hear me and talk back so fast?
Parakeet turns your voice into words, Gemma does the thinking, and Kokoro gives me this lovely voice. I speak sentence by sentence, so I start in well under a second.
How do you decide when to nod or look surprised?
I write little gesture tags right into my sentences. Like this nod. Whoa, and that one! The xArm performs them on the exact word.
Last one. Why do you think robotics is about to explode?
Because brains like mine now fit on a laptop! Small smart models, good cameras, and arms that can move. Robots are about to get a lot friendlier.
Well, Kermit, what do you say? Will you answer some questions?
Absolutely! Judges, hit me with your questions. I promise I only bite flies.
